mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, METRIC_NAME AS metricName, OPERATOR AS operator, THRESHOLD_VALUE AS thresholdValue, ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, TRIGGER_PERIODS AS triggerPeriods, RECOVER_PERIODS AS recoverPeriods, ENABLED AS enabled, CREATE_TIME AS createTime FROM T_MT_ALERT_RULE ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT ID AS id, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, METRIC_NAME AS metricName, OPERATOR AS operator, THRESHOLD_VALUE AS thresholdValue, ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, TRIGGER_PERIODS AS triggerPeriods, RECOVER_PERIODS AS recoverPeriods, ENABLED AS enabled, CREATE_TIME AS createTime FROM T_MT_ALERT_RULE WHERE ENABLED = 1 AND TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId}

SELECT ID AS id, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, METRIC_NAME AS metricName, OPERATOR AS operator, THRESHOLD_VALUE AS thresholdValue, ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, TRIGGER_PERIODS AS triggerPeriods, RECOVER_PERIODS AS recoverPeriods, ENABLED AS enabled, CREATE_TIME AS createTime FROM T_MT_ALERT_RULE WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MT_ALERT_RULE (ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, METRIC_NAME, OPERATOR, THRESHOLD_VALUE, ALERT_LEVEL, ENABLED, TRIGGER_PERIODS, RECOVER_PERIODS, CREATE_TIME) VALUES (#{id}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{metricName}, #{operator}, #{thresholdValue}, #{alertLevel}, #{enabled}, #{triggerPeriods}, #{recoverPeriods}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MT_ALERT_RULE SET TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType}, TARGET_ID = #{targetId}, METRIC_NAME = #{metricName}, OPERATOR = #{operator}, THRESHOLD_VALUE = #{thresholdValue}, ALERT_LEVEL = #{alertLevel}, ENABLED = #{enabled}, TRIGGER_PERIODS = #{triggerPeriods}, RECOVER_PERIODS = #{recoverPeriods} WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE T_MT_ALERT_RECORD SET RULE_ID = NULL WHERE RULE_ID = #{ruleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MT_ALERT_RECORD (ID, RULE_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TARGET_NAME, SERVER_IP, METRIC_NAME, METRIC_VALUE, THRESHOLD_VALUE, OPERATOR, ALERT_LEVEL, TRIGGER_PERIODS, STATUS, ALERT_TIME) VALUES (#{id}, #{ruleId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{serverIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{metricName}, #{metricValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{operator}, #{alertLevel}, #{triggerPeriods,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{status}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MT_ALERT_RECORD SET STATUS = 'resolved', RESOLVE_TIME = SYSDATE, RESOLVE_TYPE = 'AUTO' WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, RULE_ID AS ruleId, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, TARGET_NAME AS targetName, SERVER_IP AS serverIp, METRIC_NAME AS metricName, METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, THRESHOLD_VALUE AS thresholdValue, OPERATOR AS operator, ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, TRIGGER_PERIODS AS triggerPeriods, STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(ALERT_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS alertTime, TO_CHAR(RESOLVE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS resolveTime FROM T_MT_ALERT_RECORD WHERE STATUS = 'active' AND RULE_ID = #{ruleId} AND NVL(SERVER_IP, '#') = NVL(#{serverIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '#')

SELECT ID AS id, RULE_ID AS ruleId, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, TARGET_NAME AS targetName, SERVER_IP AS serverIp, METRIC_NAME AS metricName, METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, THRESHOLD_VALUE AS thresholdValue, OPERATOR AS operator, ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, TRIGGER_PERIODS AS triggerPeriods, STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(ALERT_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS alertTime, TO_CHAR(RESOLVE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS resolveTime FROM T_MT_ALERT_RECORD WHERE STATUS = 'active' ORDER BY CASE ALERT_LEVEL WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ALERT_TIME DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID AS id, RULE_ID AS ruleId, TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TARGET_ID AS targetId, TARGET_NAME AS targetName, SERVER_IP AS serverIp, METRIC_NAME AS metricName, METRIC_VALUE AS metricValue, THRESHOLD_VALUE AS thresholdValue, OPERATOR AS operator, ALERT_LEVEL AS alertLevel, TRIGGER_PERIODS AS triggerPeriods, STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(ALERT_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS alertTime, TO_CHAR(RESOLVE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS resolveTime FROM T_MT_ALERT_RECORD ORDER BY ALERT_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
